```plato
    //==
    // # Oriented-box and rounded-box bodies
    //
    // Volume, surface area, bounds, centroid, containment, nearest-point and support
    // bodies for the types declared in `spatial-primitives.types.plato`. The frame helpers,
    // and the conventions governing every body here, are in the shared section above.

    //==
    // # Box3D
    //
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cuboid

    // Width times height times depth.
    Volume(b: Box3D): Number
        => b.Size.Width * b.Size.Height * b.Size.Depth;
```

## Line 197

**Source:** [stdlib/geometry/spatial-primitives.library.plato, line 197](../../../../../stdlib/geometry/spatial-primitives.library.plato#L197).

```plato

    // Steiner's parallel-body volume (see the section note).
    Volume(b: RoundedBox3D): Number
    {
        var r = b.EffectiveCornerRadius;
        var e = b.CoreExtents;
        var faces = e.X * e.Y + e.X * e.Z + e.Y * e.Z;
        return e.X * e.Y * e.Z
            + 2.0 * r * faces
            + Number.Pi * r.Square * (e.X + e.Y + e.Z)
            + 4.0 / 3.0 * Number.Pi * r.Cube;
    }
```

```plato
    // The cylindrical middle pi*r^2*L plus the two hemispherical ends, which
    // together make one whole ball (4/3)*pi*r^3.
    Volume(c: Capsule3D): Number
        => Number.Pi * c.Radius.Square * c.SpineLength + 4.0 / 3.0 * Number.Pi * c.Radius.Cube;
```

```plato
    //==
    // # Cylinder, pipe, cone, and frustum bodies
    //
    // Volume, surface area, bounds, centroid, containment and support bodies for the

    // bodies are in the capsule section; the frame and disk-extent helpers, and the

    //==
    // # Cylinder
    //
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cylinder

    // pi * r^2 * h.
    Volume(c: Cylinder): Number
        => Number.Pi * c.Radius.Square * c.Height;
```

```plato
    // (pi * h / 3) * (r1^2 + r1*r2 + r2^2).
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frustum#Volume
    Volume(f: ConicalFrustum): Number
        => Number.Pi * f.Height
        * (f.BottomRadius.Square + f.BottomRadius * f.TopRadius + f.TopRadius.Square) / 3.0;
```

```plato
    //==
    // # Wedge
    //
    // A triangular prism: the Base triangle swept by Offset, possibly obliquely.

    // |(AB x AC) . Offset| / 2 — the base area times the component of Offset
    // perpendicular to the base. Correct for an oblique sweep (Cavalieri).
    Volume(w: Wedge): Number
        => w.Base.TwiceVectorArea.Dot(w.Offset).Abs * 0.5;
```

```plato

    //==
    // # Torus bodies
    //
    // Volume, surface area, bounds, centroid and containment bodies for the type
    // declared in `spatial-primitives.types.plato`. Volume and surface area come from Pappus's
    // centroid theorem and are valid only for the non-self-intersecting ring torus. The
    // disk-extent helper, and the conventions governing every body here, are in the
    // shared section above.

    //==
    // # Torus
    //
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Torus

    // 2 * pi^2 * R * r^2 — Pappus's centroid theorem applied to the minor disk swept
    // around the major circle. Valid only for the non-self-intersecting ring torus
    // (r <= R), which the declaration flags.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pappus%27s_centroid_theorem
    Volume(t: Torus): Number
        => 2.0 * Number.Pi.Square * t.MajorRadius * t.MinorRadius.Square;
```
